upper-trishuli-1-rasuwa.conditions_add: IFC said that, as a requirement of its financing, the company would finalize a Biodiversity Management Plan before the first disbursement and would monitor flow in medium-risk springs during tunnel construction (IFC, Environmental and Social Review Summary). Its Environmental and Social Action Plan required the company to fund the Indigenous Peoples Plan and appoint an external monitor, and to submit the headworks and fish ladder design to the lenders for approval before building the headworks (IFC). IFC said the project's impacts must be managed in line with its Performance Standards (IFC).

why.safeguard: as a requirement of its financing, the company would finalize a Biodiversity Management Plan before the first disbursement

canbalam-barillas.conditions_add: Under its 2008 investment, IFC required CIFI to run an environmental and social management system in line with IFC's Performance Standards and to apply those standards to new investments; amending those procedures to take in IFC's comments was the one environmental and social condition of IFC's first disbursement (CAO, 2018 investigation report). The legal agreement also required an annual environmental and social performance report and notice to IFC within three days of any project-level incident that could harm the application of the Performance Standards (CAO, 2018). After the May 2012 violence the lenders halted disbursements, and in October 2012 CIFI wrote to Hidro Santa Cruz setting conditions for further disbursements based on a social risk monitoring report (CAO, 2018).

why.safeguard: IFC required CIFI to run an environmental and social management system in line with IFC's Performance Standards

The banks did not disclose the specific measures agreed with the company (Human Rights Watch, 2019).

why.safeguard: required Feronia and PHC to comply with the IFC Performance Standards

karachi-brt-red-line-university-road.conditions_add: ADB's project administration manual barred handing over any section to the works contractor until compensation at full replacement cost was paid to all affected people and the resettlement plan was carried out as verified by an external monitor, and barred contractors from any work site until its site-specific environmental management plan was approved by the project unit (ADB, Project Administration Manual). The AIIB loan to Pakistan is sovereign-backed, applies ADB's 2009 Safeguard Policy Statement, and made appointment of a chief executive, finance, procurement and safeguards officers acceptable to AIIB and ADB a condition of disbursement (AIIB, project document). All procurement had to follow ADB's procurement policy, with open competitive bidding for works of US$15 million or more (ADB, Project Administration Manual).

why.safeguard: barred handing over any section to the works contractor until compensation at full replacement cost was paid
why.repay: The AIIB loan to Pakistan is sovereign-backed

The guarantees could take effect only once full construction financing, all project agreements and host country environmental approvals were in place, with compliance with the World Bank Performance Standards, and the project company was to covenant to comply with those standards (World Bank, PAD).

why.repay: right to require the government to reimburse it immediately on demand
